pattern: Rust modules by topic; `impl Page` is split across modules as several `impl Page` blocks in one crate, the struct and its fields stay in engine.rs
note: engine.rs keeps Camera, MIN_TILES, Page, SentRoot, `Page::new` and the tests, and gains `mod page_edits; mod page_layout; mod page_frame; mod page_preview; mod pictures; mod worker;` with `pub use pictures::Pictures; pub use worker::Worker;`, so `crate::engine::{Page, Worker, Pictures, Camera}` stay the same names. Fields of Page that the new modules read become `pub(crate)`. `Page::frame` (233 lines) and `reroute_after` (110) are long methods; Rust functions are not gated, but each is cut at its phases in phase 2 (frame: tiles, cards, overlays; reroute_after: find, route, write). worker.rs is at 370: if it grows, its painting methods (paint, ink_areas, invalidate, discard_stale, next: 171 lines) go to worker_paint.rs as a second `impl Worker`.
